entries.title: Inline property profile — click a listing, page prev/next without leaving the chat
bullets: Results show as your real listing cards in the conversation; clicking one opens the real property page inline (/loren/p/:id) inside the Loren shell.
A slim header gives Back to conversation and Prev / Next to page through the whole result set (with '3 of 24').
The full, filterable /search page is still one tap away via the Full search page toggle.

Why the cards (not the full page) for clicking: your card's PIN badge isn't the database id, so the only reliable way to know which listing you clicked is to render the real card grid where Loren holds the actual listing.
